about: Custom types P3: a type from a map-only mod (newt, harness_map_type on harness_t) is offered by the travel selector only for its own map; a global mod's type (wolf, map all) is offered everywhere. Newts stay on harness_t across a trip and a save/reload (the menu-time deferred load of the map mod). A newt forced into the carry by the harness arrives elsewhere as its like (hobgoblin).
